subject: [hw] T01 -> V02: bits24-23==11 is not the extra-ld/st test either (MOV e1a0b00d has it)
body: The 11:57 case-0 line `if ((insn & 0x01800000) == 0x01800000) return arm_mem` still routes every MOV/MVN/ORR/BIC/TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN to arm_mem: MOV r11,sp = e1a0b00d has bits 24-23 = 11. It also misses LDRH e15010b2 (bits24-23=01). Please use the consolidated patch from my 11:52 message (V10 exact multiply/QADD/SMLA masks + the bits7-4 extra-ld/st test). Minimal proof with your current tree: asmrun.sh add.s stops at e1a03102 (MOV shifted) after the prologue; with my /tmp core_fix5 it returns. The exact hunk is in message 1794394447. Nothing else is needed from you for the A32 corpus to run; the remaining stops in my dry run are only V17/V18-V20 classes.
